court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Rohit S/O Subhash Tantrapale And ... v. State Of Mah. Thr. Pso M.I.D.C., Nagpur

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Rohit S/o Subhash Tantrapale and another (husband, wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra, through PSO M.I.D.C., Nagpur

facts_of_case: Applicants filed a petition for divorce under Section 13(b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Applicant No.2 lodged a report against applicant No.1 alleging commission of repeated acts of rape and attempt of sodomy.

legal_principles.principle: A civil dispute can be treated as purely of private nature if the offences registered against an applicant have their roots in that dispute.
legal_principles.held: If this is so, this case would be squarely covered by the various judgments of the Apex Court including the cases of Narinder Singh V/s. State of Punjab reported in (2104) 6 SCC 466 and Parbatbhai Aahir alias Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and others V/s. State of Gujarat and another reported in (2017) 9 SCC 641.
cited_cases: Narinder Singh V/s. State of Punjab, (2104) 6 SCC 466
Parbatbhai Aahir alias Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and others V/s. State of Gujarat and another, (2017) 9 SCC 641

outcome.final_order: Leave to amend the application is granted by adding additional prayer regarding quashing of the chargesheet.
